standard_reference_review.warning: Summary bounds include 20 construction/reference leaves and are not physical robot dimensions.

limitations: Discrete samples only; no continuous-angle or exhaustive combined-state certification.

FCL uses 0.5 mm tessellation. For each candidate pair one maximum-depth witness was confirmed using BRep intersection or a positive-radius ball strictly inside both exact solids. A zero overlap at one candidate witness does not exclude overlap at other samples.
No blanket 0.2 mm running-clearance claim is made for the whole robot.
Antenna +/-90 degrees is a geometric diagnostic, not a verified physical operating limit.
Legacy MuJoCo dynamics, unmeasured actuator response and stall-torque cap cannot validate current STEP dynamics or continuous duty.
Physical servo calibration, hardware limits, cables, screw thread engagement and structural strength are unverified.
